data.long_meaning: The name Frager is derived from the Greek word 'phragmos', meaning 'a freedman'. It was a common name for slaves who had been set free in ancient Greece. In Christianity, the name can symbolize spiritual freedom and liberation from sin. The name Frager carries the meaning “Liberator, Free Man” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Frager usually hope their child will grow to embody liberator, free man and live with faith, good character and purpose.
